# scripts/puente/test_medidor_cloudroom.py
    def test_cuenta_hilos_cloud_de_30_dias_en_milisegundos(self):
        ahora = 1_800_000_000
        hilos = [{"executionTarget": "cloud", "createdAt": (ahora - 1) * 1000},
                 {"executionTarget": "cloud", "createdAt": (ahora - 31 * 86400) * 1000},
                 {"executionTarget": "local", "createdAt": ahora * 1000}]
        llamadas = []
        def runner(args, **kwargs):
            llamadas.append(args)
            datos = {"threads": hilos}
            return CompletedProcess(args, 0, json.dumps(datos), "")
        med = cloud.leer(ahora=ahora, runner=runner, cli="fake-room-cli")
        self.assertEqual(med["ventanas"][0]["usado"], 1)
        self.assertIn("--include-archived", llamadas[0])
        self.assertIn("--include-hidden", llamadas[0])
        self.assertIn("thread", llamadas[0])

            {"id": "claude-code", "model": "sonnet", "models": [{"model": "opus"}]}]})]
